name: ZIC Auto Pay – Chuyển khoản QR, xử lý đơn hàng tự động for WooCommerce
author: ZIC

sections.description:
ZIC Auto Pay helps WordPress / WooCommerce websites create QR bank transfer payments for customers while also supporting automatic order processing immediately after payment.

This plugin is suitable for store owners who want a more convenient bank transfer experience, reduced manual payment checking, and simpler order handling on WordPress / WooCommerce.

After setup, the website can display a payment QR code for customers directly on the payment page. When the customer transfers with the correct payment content, the system works with the ZIC Auto Pay Android app to recognize matching payment information from balance change notifications and send suitable data to the website to support order processing.

Key features

  • Create QR bank transfer payments for customers on WordPress / WooCommerce websites
  • Support automatic order processing after payment 24/7
  • Simple setup, with website connection by scanning a QR code
  • Reduce manual payment checking work
  • No need to enter banking username, password, or OTP code
  • Support popular Vietnamese banks
  • Free for up to 10 orders per day to get started easily

Suitable for

  • Online store owners selling on WordPress / WooCommerce websites
  • Store owners who want a more convenient bank transfer payment flow
  • Store owners who want to reduce manual payment checking
  • Store owners who want faster and more accurate payment and order handling

How it works

  1. Install the ZIC Auto Pay plugin on your WordPress / WooCommerce website
  2. Enter your bank account information so the website can display a payment QR code for customers
  3. Install the ZIC Auto Pay app on Android
  4. Scan the QR code to connect the app with the website
  5. Select a suitable banking app to help recognize payment information from balance change notifications
  6. The system sends suitable data to the website to support order processing

Why it is easy to get started

  • Suitable for individual sellers and online stores
  • No complicated configuration required
  • No need to enter banking username, password, or OTP
  • Simple website connection by scanning a QR code
  • Free for up to 10 orders per day to try in real usage

Learn more

  • WordPress plugin installation guide: https://zap.zic.vn/huong-dan-cai-dat-wordpress-plugin-zic-auto-pay/
  • App installation guide: https://zap.zic.vn/huong-dan-cai-dat-app-zic-auto-pay/
  • Demo: https://zap.zic.vn/link/wp-demo
  • Website: https://zap.zic.vn/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIC Auto Pay plugin to your WordPress website
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page
  3. Open the ZIC Auto Pay menu in the admin area
  4. Enter your payment information so the website can display a QR bank transfer payment for customers
  5. Install the ZIC Auto Pay app on Android
  6. Open the app and scan the pairing QR code on the website to connect
  7. Select a suitable banking app to help recognize payment information
  8. Complete setup and start using the plugin
sections.faq:
Can I use it for free?

Yes. ZIC Auto Pay is free for up to 10 orders per day. If your daily order volume is below this limit, you can get started without paying.

Is the setup complicated?

No. ZIC Auto Pay is designed to be simple, helping store owners get started without complicated configuration.

Do I need to install both the WordPress plugin and the ZIC Auto Pay app?

Yes. The WordPress plugin is used to display the payment QR code and support order processing on the website. The ZIC Auto Pay Android app is used to connect with the website and help recognize payment information from balance change notifications.

Do I need to pay to install the WordPress plugin?

No. You can install the plugin and start using it with the free limit of 10 orders per day.

Can I view a demo before installation?

Yes. You can view the demo here: https://zap.zic.vn/link/wp-demo

Is the app safe for my bank account?

ZIC Auto Pay does not require you to enter your banking username, password, or OTP code.

Which platforms does ZIC Auto Pay currently support?

Currently, ZIC Auto Pay supports WordPress / WooCommerce websites and the Android app for pairing, payment recognition support, and order processing support.
